Heartbeat — periodic maintenance runtime.

Runs a set of registered tasks on a fixed interval using Chronos. Each task is a fire-and-forget gcsafe proc.

Usage: var reg = newHeartbeatRegistry() reg.registerTask("reminders", myReminderTask) startHeartbeat(reg, intervalSec = 60)

Concrete tasks shipped here: deliverDueReminders — polls MemoryRuntimePort for due reminders, delivers via outbox fn.
